get = asyncio.ensure_future(source.get())
finished, _ = await asyncio.wait({get, stop_wait}, return_when=asyncio.FIRST_COMPLETED)
if get not in finished:
    get.cancel()
    break
message = get.result()

label: Start the handler, at most `concurrency` at a time
code:
await slots.acquire()
task = asyncio.create_task(work(message))
in_flight.add(task)
task.add_done_callback(in_flight.discard)

label: Let running handlers finish, but only for `grace` seconds
Cancel what is still running and wait until it stopped
code:
leftovers = list(in_flight)
for task in leftovers:
    task.cancel()
await asyncio.gather(*leftovers, return_exceptions=True)
